prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Coloured full-body bestiary portrait, grounded hand-painted realistic game illustration. Broad readable brushwork, smooth light-to-shadow gradients across large forms, quiet surfaces with selective crisp detail at silhouette and focal features. No uniform high-frequency texture, craquelure, fractal cracks or sharpening noise. Soft upper-left light, muted natural colours. Empty dark charcoal subtly mottled backdrop, restrained contact shading only. Entire subject, feet, tails and tips inside comfortable margins. Portrait aspect about 4:5. No captions, symbols, border or circular crop. 
One tiny Moloch RECONNAISSANCE robot, low oval metal abdomen the size of a small dog, compact front cephalothorax. EXACTLY EIGHT slim mechanical walking legs: four distinct bolted roots per side, angular articulated limbs with needle-point feet. No extra gun arms. Front face has exactly EIGHT independent small dark glass sensor lenses, two rows of four. Low utilitarian blackened steel and faded olive surfaces, two cable loops, broad local rust patches at a few seams. Scout designed to hide, no heavy tank armour, cannon, missile pods or glowing fantasy eyes. Three-quarter front view slightly from above makes all eight legs countable and keeps all tips complete. Quiet broad metal faces with selective joint bolts. Reference painting only: no dog anatomy or organic limbs.
